name: Lyria Du Lac
summary: In Goldshire, Lyria Du Lac trains young warriors behind the village smithy. She teaches them to master their stances and arms.

sections.title: Warrior Trainer of Goldshire
sections.body: Lyria Du Lac trains young warriors in the yard behind Goldshire's forge. She teaches those fresh from Northshire Abbey, judges their readiness, and introduces specialized combat techniques. Warriors take up shield and blade for Stormwind, facing the threats of Elwynn Forest.

faq.q: Where can I find Lyria Du Lac?
faq.answer: In Goldshire, find Lyria Du Lac outside behind the blacksmith shop, just west of the Lion's Pride Inn.

faq.q: What service does Lyria Du Lac provide?
faq.answer: Lyria Du Lac trains warriors in combat maneuvers, stances, and battle disciplines as they advance in skill.

faq.q: What quests involve Lyria Du Lac?
faq.answer: Lyria Du Lac gives developing warriors 'A Warrior's Training'. She sends them to veteran Harry Burlguard at the Pig and Whistle tavern in Stormwind's Old Town.

angles.text: As a warrior fresh from Northshire Abbey, you meet Lyria Du Lac, your first major trainer in Elwynn Forest. She helps you master your stance and sharpen your melee tactics.
Behind Goldshire's forge, Lyria Du Lac trains local recruits to defend Stormwind's heartland from Defias brigands and gnoll raiders.
